Sandbox_BatteryJumpstarter_SuccessChance: Chance (in percent) that using a jumpstarter on a car battery succeeds.
Sandbox_BatteryJumpstarter_BatteryCharge: Charge (in percent) a car battery is set to after a successful jumpstart.
Sandbox_BatteryJumpstarter_MaxBatteryCha: A car battery can only be jumpstarted if its charge (in percent) is at or below this value.
Sandbox_BatteryJumpstarter_FuelPerCharge: Litres of generator fuel consumed to recharge one jumpstarter use. A full generator holds 10 L.
